title: DriverDebtStatusChanged v1 payload
description: Published by finance when a driver's debt in a currency crosses the admin's limit in either direction (REQ-PAY-16). Operations stops or resumes new orders for the driver; a trip in progress is not affected. status_version grows per driver and currency; a lower one is stale.

owed_minor.description: What the driver owes the service; negative when the service owes him.
